The figure presents a line graph comparing the performance of three models, labeled as "lattice," "FLAT," and "OURS," in terms of model inference speed. The x-axis represents the number of epochs, ranging from 0 to 18, with increments of 2. The y-axis represents the model inference speed, with values ranging from 0.50 to 0.60, although the unit is not specified. 

The graph displays three lines, each representing one of the models: the red line for "lattice," the blue line for "FLAT," and the yellow line for "OURS." The "lattice" line starts at approximately 0.51 and ends at 0.54; the "FLAT" line starts at 0.52 and ends at 0.57; and the "OURS" line starts at 0.53 and ends at 0.58.
